originalTitle: What we know so far about the Microsoft outage
summary: A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.
content:
A Microsoft outage is affecting services including Teams, Outlook and AI software Copilot.

Microsoft has said the problem was caused by a higher-than-usual stress on its servers but that systems were now showing "early signs of stabilisation" as work continued on a fix.

The BBC's technology reporter Shiona McCallum explains what we know.

Read more about the Microsoft outage.
chineseTitle: 到目前为止我们对微软宕机的了解
chineseSummary: Microsoft 的故障影响了 Teams、Outlook 和 AI 软件 Copilot 等服务。
chineseContent:
Microsoft 的故障影响了 Teams、Outlook 和 AI 软件 Copilot 等服务。

微软表示，该问题是由于其服务器承受的压力高于平时造成的，但随着修复工作的继续，系统现在显示出“稳定的早期迹象”。

BBC 科技记者 Shiona McCallum 解释了我们所知道的情况。

了解有关 Microsoft 中断的更多信息。
